faq.q: What is included in the Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas?
faq.a: The 2-hour sunset cruise includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, Spanish IVA (21%), and a selection of drinks: champagne, cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. Light tapas-style snacks are also provided. You just need to bring your group and enjoy the evening.

faq.q: How many guests can join the sunset cruise?
faq.a: Our Azimut 39 accommodates up to 11 guests. The boat is 12.5 meters long with ample deck space for sunset viewing. The price is a flat €749 for the entire charter, not per person, making it an excellent value for groups.

faq.q: Where does the sunset cruise depart from?
faq.a: All departures are from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. We meet at the boat berth 15 minutes before departure. The exact berth number is confirmed upon booking via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What time does the sunset cruise start?
faq.a: Departure times vary by season to align with sunset. Typically, we set sail 1.5 hours before sunset. In summer (June–August), that's around 20:00; in spring/autumn (April–May, September–October), around 19:00. We confirm the exact time when you book.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or drinks?
faq.a: Our charter includes champagne, tapas, and a full drinks selection, so no need to bring extras. However, if you have specific dietary requirements or want additional catering, let us know during booking and we can arrange it at an extra cost.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for the sunset cruise?
faq.a: We require 48 hours' notice for a full refund. Within 48 hours, cancellations are non-refundable. If we cancel due to unsafe weather (high winds, storms), you receive a full refund or can reschedule.

faq.q: Is the sunset cruise suitable for children?
faq.a: Yes, children are welcome. The boat has safety rails and life jackets for all sizes. However, please note that alcohol is served to adults only. The cruise is a relaxed, family-friendly experience.

faq.q: How do I book the Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas?
faq.a: Book directly via WhatsApp. Contact us on +34 123 456 789 with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests. We'll confirm availability, send payment details, and provide the meeting point. Payment is by bank transfer or card.

data.body_html:
Few experiences rival a Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas 2036 aboard a luxury motor yacht. Departing from Puerto Banús, this 2-hour evening charter on the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) offers front-row seats to the Costa del Sol's golden hour—with chilled champagne, Spanish tapas, and the silhouette of La Concha mountain. At €749 for the whole boat (skipper, fuel, drinks, and IVA included), it's a private sunset party for up to 11 guests, costing as little as €68 per person.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise from Puerto Banús?

Puerto Banús is Marbella's glamorous marina, lined with designer boutiques and superyachts. Departing from here means you're minutes from the open sea, with the Golden Mile stretching east and the Sierra Blanca mountains rising behind. The sunset views are exceptional: the sun dips into the Mediterranean, painting the sky in shades of orange and pink, while the lights of Marbella begin to twinkle. Our boat rental Marbella fleet ensures a seamless experience.

The Boat: Azimut 39 – Perfect for Sunset Charters

The Azimut 39 is a 12.5-metre flybridge cruiser with a spacious aft deck and forward sunpad, ideal for socialising. It accommodates up to 11 guests and cruises at 22 knots, covering the coast from Banús to Cabopino in under 20 minutes. The flybridge offers panoramic views—perfect for sunset photography. Amenities include a sound system, fridge, and shaded cockpit. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%).

What's Included: Champagne, Tapas & More

Your sunset cruise includes a welcome glass of champagne, followed by a selection of Spanish tapas (jamón, cheese, olives, bread with tomato). The open bar offers cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. Snacks and drinks are replenished throughout the 2-hour trip. No hidden extras—the price is all-inclusive. For groups wanting more, we can arrange a private chef or premium champagne at an additional cost.

Typical Sunset Cruise Itinerary

  • Departure: 1.5 hours before sunset from Puerto Banús
  • Coastal cruise: Head west toward Cala del Faro or east toward Cabopino, depending on wind
  • Sunset stop: Anchor in a calm bay (e.g., Cala Cortés) to watch the sunset with drinks
  • Return: Dusk cruise back to Puerto Banús, arriving after sunset
  • Total duration: 2 hours (flexible by arrangement)

Pricing & Availability for 2036

The Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas 2036 is priced at €749 for 2 hours (up to 11 guests). This is a Tier A charter, same as the Astondoa 40. For longer cruises (e.g., 4 hours), pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Availability is high from April to October, with summer evenings booking fast. To secure your date, contact us at least 48 hours in advance.

How to Book Your Sunset Cruise

Booking is simple: send a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests. We'll confirm availability, send a payment link (bank transfer or card), and provide the exact berth in Puerto Banús. Payment secures your slot. For questions, see our FAQ page or contact us directly.
